newsitem.title: GREECE: ErgoBank H1 pretax up 37.5pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: ErgoBank H1 pretax up 37.5pct yr/yr.

text.p: ErgoBank, Greece's second largest private commercial bank, said its half-year pretax profit grew 37.5 percent to 25.63 billion drachmas from 18.63 billion a year earlier.
The bank cited growth in operations as a reason for its improved financial results.
"As of end-June, loans and deposits were respectively up 34.1 and 28.7 percent year-on-year," it said.
Equity stood at around 100 billion drachmas following the seven-for-20 rights issue at 4,000 drachmas which raised 26.5 billion drachmas in February 1997, the bank said.
